s.note: King prawns in garlic, chilli and lemon, grilled hot on skewers over the coals.
s.how: Toss 600g peeled king prawns with 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped chilli, lemon zest and 2 tbsp oil. Thread onto skewers and grill hot for 90 seconds a side. Brush with 50g butter melted with grated lemon zest and serve with lemon.

s.note: Squid rings in golden breadcrumbs, fried crisp, with lemon wedges and tartare.
s.how: Cut 500g cleaned squid tubes into 1cm rings and pat dry. Dust in 75g seasoned plain flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and press into 150g dried breadcrumbs. Heat vegetable oil 4cm deep to 180C and fry in batches for 2 minutes until golden. Drain, salt and serve with lemon wedges and 150g tartare sauce.

m.note: Crisp-skin barra. Bring a big knife.
m.how: Score the skin of 4 barramundi fillets and pat very dry. Grill skin down over high heat until crisp, about 4 minutes, then flip for 1 minute. Melt 80g butter with 2 garlic cloves and a squeeze of lemon and spoon over.

w.note: Stewed Granny Smiths under a buttery oat crumble, hot custard poured over.
w.how: Heat the oven to 180C. Peel, core and slice 6 Granny Smith apples and stew with 60g caster sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 2 tbsp water for 10 minutes. Tip into a baking dish. Rub 100g cold butter into 100g plain flour, then stir in 60g rolled oats and 80g brown sugar and scatter over the apples. Bake 30 minutes until golden and serve hot with 600ml warm custard.

d.n: Walkabout Creek rum and ginger beer
d.note: Dark rum and ginger beer over ice.
d.how: Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Squeeze 15ml lime juice into each and add 150ml chilled ginger beer. Slowly pour 45ml dark rum over the back of a spoon so it floats on top. Add a lime wedge and stir at the table.
